articles.summary: For commercial finance brokers, growth has traditionally been a volume game: generate more leads, build more lender relationships, submit more deals, and hope that more of them close.But that model has a ceiling.
articles.title: How Brokers Can Optimize Deal Flow From Application to Funding

articles.summary: A soft credit pull checks your credit without affecting your score, while a hard credit pull happens when you apply for new credit and can temporarily lower your score by a few points. The difference matters because hard inquiries are visible to other lenders and can influence future credit decisions, whereas soft inquiries remain invisible to everyone but you.
articles.title: Soft Pull vs. Hard Pull: What Is the Difference and Why Does It Matter

articles.summary: Financial health data measures how well people or businesses manage money across four dimensions: spending, saving, borrowing, and planning. Unlike a credit score that reflects past behavior, financial health data captures current financial stability—giving lenders a real-time view of whether someone can actually afford to repay.
articles.title: Financial Health Data for Smarter Credit Decisions

articles.summary: Business broker lender partnerships connect deal-makers with the capital sources that actually fund transactions—and when they work well, everyone wins. With 45% of small firms seeking financing in 2025, brokers close more deals, lenders get qualified applications, and SMB buyers secure funding faster than they could on their own.
articles.title: Business Broker Lender Partnerships: How Lendflow Makes It Work

articles.summary: A credit score tells you where a borrower has been. Borrower health data tells you where they're headed—and whether they can actually repay.
articles.title: The Role of Borrower Health Data in Modern Credit Underwriting

articles.summary: A fraud detection stack is a layered system of tools, data sources, rules, machine learning models, and human review workflows that work together to identify and block fraudulent activity across the customer lifecycle. Each layer catches what the others miss—identity verification flags fake documents, device signals spot suspicious logins, ML models detect patterns too complex for rules alone.
articles.title: What Is a Fraud Detection Stack and How Do You Build One

articles.summary: Most loan placement still runs on spreadsheets, phone calls, and a handful of lender relationships built over years. That approach worked when volumes were manageable—but it doesn't scale, and it leaves money on the table every time a qualified borrower gets declined by the wrong lender.
articles.title: The Top 7 Data-Driven Loan Placement Tools for 2026

articles.summary: Multi-lender underwriting orchestration connects borrower data, credit decisioning, and multiple lending partners in one workflow. Instead of building separate integrations and underwriting processes for every lender, businesses can use an orchestration layer to evaluate an application, determine which lenders fit, route the deal, and manage the response from one system.
articles.title: Top Providers for Multi-Lender Underwriting Orchestration in 2026

articles.summary: A credit scorecard turns borrower data into a single number that predicts default risk—and unlike black-box models, every point is traceable to a specific attribute. Lenders build scorecards to make faster, more consistent credit decisions while staying audit-ready.
articles.title: How to Build a Credit Scorecard From Scratch

articles.summary: Commercial loan brokers live in a world of competing demands—borrowers want updates, lenders want clean submissions, and deals stall when communication breaks down. A purpose-built CRM designed for commercial lending handles both sides of that equation without forcing you to duct-tape spreadsheets to your email inbox.
articles.title: Top Commercial Loan Broker CRM Platforms Ranked for 2026

articles.summary: A credit waterfall is a financing structure where a single loan application automatically routes through multiple lenders in sequence until one approves it. Instead of a decline ending the process, the application cascades to the next lender in line—no re-submission, no additional paperwork from the borrower.
articles.title: Credit Waterfall 101: A Complete Guide for Lenders

articles.summary: Automated underwriting is a software-driven process that uses algorithms and data analytics to evaluate risk and make instant loan decisions without relying entirely on manual human review. Instead of a loan officer manually reviewing every document and data point, the system pulls information, checks it against your credit policy, and produces a decision in seconds.
articles.title: Automated Underwriting: The Lender's Guide to Faster Decisions

articles.summary: Loan stacking is the practice of applying for and securing multiple loans from different lenders in rapid succession—timed so the new debts don't appear on credit reports before each approval. It's a tactic that exploits reporting delays, and it creates serious risk for both borrowers who overextend and lenders who fund deals without full visibility.
articles.title: Loan Stacking Explained: Risks for Lenders and Borrowers

Lendflow was scheduled to participate in the event but ultimately was not able to attend.
